title: Greenspan 'Irrational Exuberance' Speech
description: Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan warns of 'irrational exuberance' in the stock market, hinting at potential monetary tightening.

title: Fed Cuts Rates for LTCM Bailout
description: Fed initiates a 25 bps rate cut outside regular meetings to stabilize markets following the Long-Term Capital Management collapse.

title: BOJ Adopts Zero Interest Rate Policy (ZIRP)
description: Bank of Japan lowers its benchmark rate essentially to zero, beginning an era of unconventional monetary policy.

title: Washington Agreement on Gold
description: 15 European central banks agree to limit their gold sales, establishing a floor for gold prices.

title: Fed Surprise Rate Cut as Tech Bubble Bursts
description: Fed surprisingly cuts rates by 50 bps to 6% to combat economic slowdown from the dot-com crash.

title: Emergency Fed Cut Post 9/11
description: Fed cuts rates 50 bps ahead of US stock market reopening following the September 11 terrorist attacks.

title: Fed Begins 2004-2006 Hike Cycle
description: Fed raises rates from 1.00% to 1.25%, the first of 17 consecutive 25 bps hikes.

title: Fed Pauses 2004-2006 Hike Cycle
description: Fed leaves rates unchanged at 5.25% after 17 consecutive rate hikes, ending the tightening cycle.

title: Fed Emergency Discount Rate Cut
description: Fed unexpectedly cuts the discount rate by 50 bps as the subprime mortgage crisis begins to squeeze market liquidity.

title: Fed First Rate Cut of GFC Cycle
description: Fed cuts fed funds rate by 50 bps to 4.75%, initiating the Great Financial Crisis easing cycle.

title: Fed 75 bps Emergency Cut
description: Fed slashes rates by 75 bps in an emergency inter-meeting move amid plunging global stock markets.

title: Fed Announces QE1
description: Fed announces the first round of Quantitative Easing, purchasing $600 billion in MBS.

title: Fed Expands QE1 to Treasuries
description: Fed dramatically expands QE1, committing to buy $300 billion in long-term Treasury securities.

title: PBOC Reveals Large Gold Purchases
description: China reports its gold reserves have risen by 76% since 2003, signaling major central bank demand shift.

title: India Buys 200 Tonnes of IMF Gold
description: Reserve Bank of India purchases 200 metric tonnes of gold from the IMF for $6.7 billion.

title: Fed Announces QE2
description: Fed commits to purchasing $600 billion in longer-term Treasury securities to stimulate a sluggish recovery.

title: Fed Announces Operation Twist
description: Fed announces program to sell short-term Treasuries and buy $400 billion of long-term Treasuries to flatten yield curve.

title: ECB Draghi 'Whatever It Takes'
description: Mario Draghi pledges to do 'whatever it takes' to preserve the Euro, effectively ending the European sovereign debt crisis.

title: Fed Announces QE3
description: Fed announces open-ended purchases of $40 billion of agency MBS per month, later expanded to include Treasuries.

title: Bernanke Taper Tantrum
description: Ben Bernanke suggests the Fed could scale back bond purchases in coming meetings, triggering a massive bond selloff and gold plunge.

title: ECB Implements Negative Rates
description: ECB becomes the first major central bank to lower its deposit rate below zero (-0.1%).

title: Fed Ends QE3
description: The Federal Reserve formally concludes its asset purchase program (QE3).

title: PBOC Devalues the Yuan
description: China unexpectedly devalues the Yuan by nearly 2%, causing global market turmoil.

title: Fed First Hike in 9 Years
description: Fed raises rates by 25 bps to 0.25%-0.50%, the first rate hike since 2006.

title: BOJ Adopts Negative Rates
description: Bank of Japan stuns markets by cutting its benchmark rate below zero to -0.1%.

title: BOJ Implements Yield Curve Control (YCC)
description: Bank of Japan targets the 10-year JGB yield at around zero percent, shifting from volume to yield targeting.

title: Poland Begins Major Gold Purchases
description: National Bank of Poland becomes the first EU nation in two decades to add significantly to its gold reserves.

title: Powell 'Long Way from Neutral' Comment
description: Fed Chair Powell suggests rates are a long way from neutral, sparking a massive Q4 stock selloff and boosting gold later.

title: Fed's Final Hike of 2015-2018 Cycle
description: Fed hikes rates to 2.25%-2.50% despite market turmoil, ending the tightening cycle before the 2019 pivot.

title: The Powell Pivot
description: Jerome Powell signals patience on future rate hikes and flexibility on QT, reversing his hawkish stance from late 2018.

title: Fed First Rate Cut Since 2008
description: Fed cuts rates by 25 bps, labeling it a 'mid-cycle adjustment' against trade tensions and slowing global growth.

title: Fed Repo Market Intervention
description: Fed intervenes in the overnight repo market to calm severe liquidity shortages, implicitly resuming balance sheet growth.

title: Fed Emergency 50 bps Cut (COVID)
description: Fed deploys a surprise 50 bps inter-meeting rate cut as the COVID-19 pandemic roils global markets.

title: Fed Cuts Rates to Zero, Restarts QE
description: Fed slashes rates by 100 bps to 0-0.25% and announces $700 billion in asset purchases.

title: Fed 'QE Infinity'
description: Fed announces it will buy Treasuries and MBS 'in the amounts needed' to support smooth market functioning.

title: Fed Adopts Average Inflation Targeting
description: Powell announces a major policy shift at Jackson Hole, stating the Fed will allow inflation to run moderately above 2% to offset past shortfalls.

title: Fed Announces QE Taper
description: Fed formally announces it will begin reducing the pace of its monthly bond purchases.

title: Fed First Rate Hike of Post-COVID Cycle
description: Fed raises rates by 25 bps, beginning an aggressive tightening cycle to combat surging inflation.

title: Fed Hikes 75 bps
description: Fed implements a massive 75 bps rate hike, its largest single increase since 1994.

title: ECB Ends Negative Rate Era
description: ECB raises rates by a larger-than-expected 50 bps, ending 8 years of negative interest rates.

title: Record Central Bank Gold Buying Revealed
description: World Gold Council reports a massive 399 tonnes of central bank gold buying in Q3 2022, signaling a structural shift by PBOC and others.

title: BOJ Unexpectedly Widens YCC Band
description: Bank of Japan shocks markets by raising the upper limit of its 10-year yield target from 0.25% to 0.50%.

title: Fed Creates Bank Term Funding Program (BTFP)
description: Following SVB's collapse, Fed establishes an emergency lending facility allowing banks to post underwater bonds at par.

title: Turkey Leads Global Gold Purchases
description: Central Bank of Turkey emerges as the world's largest official sector gold buyer for the year amid local currency depreciation.

title: Fed's Dovish Pivot
description: Fed holds rates steady and signals the hiking cycle is effectively over, projecting 75 bps of cuts in 2024 via the dot plot.

title: BOJ Ends Negative Rates and YCC
description: Bank of Japan raises rates to 0-0.1%, terminating its complex negative interest rate and yield curve control frameworks.

title: PBOC Pauses Gold Purchases
description: China's central bank ends an 18-month streak of consecutive gold buying, leading to an immediate drop in gold prices.

title: ECB Cuts Rates Ahead of Fed
description: ECB cuts interest rates by 25 bps, moving ahead of the US Federal Reserve in the easing cycle.

title: Fed Initiates Easing Cycle with 50 bps Cut
description: Federal Reserve cuts rates by an aggressive 50 bps to 4.75%-5.00%, officially starting its easing cycle amid labor market concerns.

title: Fed Cuts Rates by 25 bps
description: Federal Reserve delivers a 25 bps rate cut following the US presidential election, continuing its gradual easing.

title: Fed Cuts Rates by 25 bps
description: Fed concludes 2024 with a widely anticipated 25 bps rate cut, bringing the total easing for the year to 100 bps.

title: Fed Pauses Rate Cuts
description: Federal Reserve leaves rates unchanged at the first meeting of 2025, signaling caution due to persistent inflation data.

title: Fed Resumes Easing with 25 bps Cut
description: Fed cuts rates by 25 bps after a temporary pause, as labor market cooling outweighs inflation concerns.

title: Fed Cuts Rates 25 bps
description: Federal Reserve cuts rates by another 25 bps, bringing the policy rate closer to the perceived neutral level.

title: Fed Pauses Easing Cycle
description: Fed signals a prolonged pause, noting that the policy rate has effectively reached the neutral bound.

title: ECB Cuts Rates Further
description: European Central Bank delivers another 25 bps rate cut to stimulate a flagging Eurozone economy.
